---
pagetitle: Lecture 1A
format:
  revealjs:
    theme: simple
    controls: false
    slide-number: true
    chalkboard: false
    preview-links: auto
    css: [../../styles.css, ../../lecture-styles.css]
    width: 1920
    height: 1080
    margin: 0.05
    min-scale: 0.2
    max-scale: 2.0
    auto-stretch: false
    html-math-method: mathml
    include-in-header:
      - file: ../../scripts/frames.html
      - file: ../../scripts/widget.html
      - text: |
          <script>
          document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
            document.querySelectorAll(".reveal .slides > section").forEach((s) => {
              if (s.classList.contains("section-title") ||
                  s.classList.contains("title-card") ||
                  s.id === "title-slide" ||
                  s.querySelector(":scope > .slide-body")) return;
              const head = [];
              let n = s.firstElementChild;
              while (n && (n.tagName === "H2" ||
                           n.classList.contains("slide-refs") ||
                           n.classList.contains("subtitle"))) {
                head.push(n);
                n = n.nextElementSibling;
              }
              const rest = [];
              while (n) { rest.push(n); n = n.nextElementSibling; }
              if (!rest.length) return;
              const body = document.createElement("div");
              body.className = "slide-body";
              rest.forEach((el) => body.appendChild(el));
              s.appendChild(body);
            });
          });
          </script>
          <script>
          if (new URLSearchParams(location.search).has("export")) {
            document.documentElement.classList.add("export-pdf");
            window.addEventListener("load", async () => {
              if (window.Reveal) {
                Reveal.configure({ minScale: 1, maxScale: 1 });
              }
              document.querySelectorAll("img[data-src]").forEach((img) => {
                img.src = img.getAttribute("data-src");
              });
              try {
                if (window.MathJax?.startup?.promise) await MathJax.startup.promise;
                if (window.MathJax?.typesetPromise) await MathJax.typesetPromise();
              } catch (e) {}
              await Promise.all([...document.images].map((img) => {
                if (img.complete) return Promise.resolve();
                return new Promise((res) => { img.onload = img.onerror = res; });
              }));
              document.documentElement.classList.add("export-ready");
            });
          }
          </script>
---
